text: But my companion, with less imagination, kept me up. “To share them—?” “She wants Flora.” Mrs. Grose might, as I gave it to her, fairly have fallen away from me had I not been prepared. I still held her there, to show I was. “As I’ve told you, however, it doesn’t matter.” “Because you’ve made up your mind? But to what?” “To everything.” “And what do you call ‘everything’?” “Why, sending for their uncle.” “Oh, miss, in pity do,” my friend broke out.
